paite: Huan tempul ah ahon pilut a, abaangkate ateh a, asik tuak ah tong guk a sah tuaktuak a-om a, huai tuh biakbuk vailam chia ahi.
english: He brought me to the nave and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.

paite: Huan alutna tong sawm a za ahi a; asik tuak ah baangkate tong nga tuaktuak ahi; huan asunglam ateh a, adunglam tong sawmli leh availam tong sawmnih ahi.
english: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.

paite: Dantan sungnung ah alut a, alutna baangkate tong nih a sah tuaktuak ahi a; alutna tong guk a za ahi a; alutna baangkate tong sagih tuaktuak ahi.
english: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.

paite: Dantan sungnung ateh a, asungpi ban ah adunglam tong sawmnih ahi a; tempul kantan availam leng tong sawmnih ahi. Huan ka kiang ah, "Hiai Mun Siangthoupen ahi," ahon chi hi.
english: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”

paite: Huan atempul baang ateh a, tong guk a sah ahi; huan tempul sik chih ah dantan tong li a za chiat a-om hi.
heading: Tempul Baang Lam Doh A Pindan Lamte
english: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.

paite: Huan chial thumte ah pang dantante a-om ua, huchi a huai lai a letkipna aneih theihlouhna ding un, tempul baang a letkipna nei lou in.
english: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.

paite: Huchi in apang dantante hong san hiaihiai in aza semsem a; tempul azuih touh ziak in, akimvel in asungpi anaih hulhul hi. Huchi in dantan nuainungpen a kipan atungnungpen pha a pai ding in alai a kantan ding ahi.
english: The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the width of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.

paite: Huan tempul kim ah suanglep vum om in ka mu a; pang dantan suangphum tehna chiang, tong guk hial a sau tan a sang ahi.
english: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.

paite: Pang dantan polam bang tong nga a sah ahi; tempul pang dantan polam baang ban ah tong nga a-awl lai hi.
english: The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.

paite: Inpi suanglep vum leh tempul huangsung dantante kikal akimvel in tong sawmnih a za ahi.
english: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.

paite: Pang dantan kongkhakte mun awng lam a hon ahi a, khat in mallam, adang khat in simlam anga a; akim a mun awng tong nga a za ahi.
english: The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.

paite: Huan tumlam a phaitam khekhiakna lam nga inn tong sawmsagih a za ahi; huai inn baang akim in tong nga a sah vek ahi a, adung tong sawmkua ahi.
heading: Tumlam A Inn
english: The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.

paite: Huan tempul ateh a tong za a sau ahi; inn phaitam mun awng leh huai tempul baang sahdan simtel in tong za ahi nawn hi.
heading: Tempul Letdan Avek A Teh Sipsip Ahi
english: So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;

paite: Tempul kongtual mun awng tong za a sau ahi.
english: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.

paite: Huan aphaitam mun awng khen inn dunglam ateh a, apang tuak abaangte huap in tong zakhat ahi.
english: He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits from the inner temple, and the porches of the court,

paite: Huan asungpite, tohlet khuam neute, polam sumtawngte singpek in athuap ua; athum un akimvel in hon theih louh tohlet leh inchial anei a; inpi lutna kongpi tan in apialkhang a kipan tohlet pha a apum a singpek a thuap ahi, tohlet leng thuap ahi lai hi.
heading: Tempul Zatdan Tehna
english: the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),

paite: Kongpi lutungte, dantan sungnung tanpha leh apolam toh, baang tengteng asunglam leh apolam tan in.
english: to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.

paite: Huaite cherub limte leh tum sing limte a zep ahi a, cherub leh cherub kikal ah tum sing a-om zel a; cherubte'n mai nih anei chiat uhi.
english: It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces,

paite: Mihing mel bang in alangkhat in tum sing lam anga a, humpinelkai tuailai mel bang in alangkhat in tum sing lam anga nawn hi. Hiaite tempul kimvel vek in agelh uhi.
english: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around.

paite: Apialkhang a kipan in kongpi tung pha in cherub leh tum sing lim a zep vek ahi; tempul baang bel huchi vek ahi.
english: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.

paite: Tempul kongpi biang khuamte tuh asah azat kibang ahi. Mun Siangthou ma ah sing a bawl maitam bangtak a-om hi.
heading: Sing Maitam
english: The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.

paite: Tong thum a sang, tong nih a za, aningte, atawte leh apangte sing a bawl vek ahi. Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai TOUPA ma a dohkan ahi,” achi hi.
english: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before Yahweh.”

paite: Tempul leh Mun Siangthou in kongkhak nih tuaktuak anei hi.
heading: Kongkhakte
english: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

paite: Kongkhak in phel nih anei tuaktuak a; aphel khat bel kheptheih chiat ahi; kongkhak khat ah phel nih, adang ah phel nih anei hi.
english: The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.

paite: Baang a agelh mah bang un tempul kongkhakte ah cherub leh tum sing lim agelh chiat lai ua; sumtawng pua ah singpek sah mahmah aphalh uhi.
english: There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.

paite: Huan sumtawng baang lang tuakte leh singpek phalhte ah tohlet hon theih louh leh tum sing lim a-om lai a; atempul pang dantan leh singpek phalh leng huchibang mah ahi.
english: There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch. This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged.
